QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` it installs mutex-wrapped variants (`buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed`, line 541), which lock around `buffer_alloc_calloc`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the mutexed variants are installed under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C. It never says a plain pair is installed otherwise, and it never says the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
